_comment: Which skills each node gets unless you choose otherwise, per node, in the UI.
mode: none -- no skills; auto -- the node is shown every skill's name and
description and reads the ones it needs; selected -- the listed skills are
given to it in full. Skill names are folder names under skills/.
`bootstrap` is the design agent's own nodes; `roles` is a designed agent's
nodes, by role -- the designer starts from these and may suggest others.
